<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def diff(f1,f2):
    a1,a2=f1.ascii.split('\n'),f2.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,u,v) for r,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a1,a2)) for c,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if u!=v]
def summ(ch):
    from collections import Counter
    return f"n={len(ch)} {dict(Counter((u,v) for _,_,u,v in ch))}" if ch else "n=0"
def mblocks(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); s=set((r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='M')
    return sorted((r,c) for r,c in s if (r+1,c) in s and (r,c+1) in s and (r+1,c+1) in s)
print("before M:",mblocks(current_frame))
b=current_frame
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':22}])
print("click(34,22):",summ(diff(b,current_frame))," M:",mblocks(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def diff(f1,f2):
    a1,a2=f1.ascii.split('\n'),f2.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,u,v) for r,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a1,a2)) for c,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if u!=v]
def summ(ch):
    from collections import Counter
    return f"n={len(ch)} {dict(Counter((u,v) for _,_,u,v in ch))}" if ch else "n=0"
def mblocks(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); s=set((r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='M')
    return sorted((r,c) for r,c in s if (r+1,c) in s and (r,c+1) in s and (r+1,c+1) in s)
print("before M:",mblocks(current_frame))
b=current_frame
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':22}])
print("click(34,22):",summ(diff(b,current_frame))," M:",mblocks(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
